mechanism: On external CPTAC the receptor heads collapse to the majority class: predicted endocrine 89% (actual 61%), antiHER2 0% (actual 12%), chemo 11% (actual 27%). (1) The HER2 head never fires positive externally (consistent with AUROC 0.53), so HER2+ is 100% mis-routed. (2) ER over-call (73% of TNBC called ER+) gives 73% chemo mis-route. The 5% endocrine mis-route reflects majority-class collapse, not H&E skill.
honest_reading: Robust result: the HER2 axis (100% mis-route under both routings; molecular test required). Endocrine/chemo per-axis cost depends on routing scheme and external calibration (PAM50 51% vs receptor 5% / PAM50 14% vs receptor 73%) and does not support a safety claim. Only the headline contrast (antiHER2-endocrine) is robust under both routings (0.340/0.381, CI excludes 0).

ci_method.note: Slide-level bootstrap is pseudo-replicated (mean 3.09 slides/patient) and underestimates the CI; patient-cluster bootstrap is used.
